text:
Ava (Content): OK team — draft hero + benchmark blurb ready. Looking for quick signoffs (design + legal) and routing confirmation from Priya.

Ava (Content): HERO ALPHA: 'Launch LLM experiences faster — predictable latency, reliable cost.'
HERO BETA: 'Lower inference spend. Maintain real-time SLAs.'
Benchmark line (body): 'Internal benchmarks: median generation latency improved by up to 3x on long-context requests versus our previous baseline.'
Proposed CTAs: `Request demo`, `View technical benchmarks`, `Get on waitlist`

Jules (Growth): Both headlines have different signal — Alpha sells speed, Beta sells economics. Recommend running a copy + CTA matrix test.

Priya (Demand): Routing plan: map CTAs to HubSpot lists as follows — `Request demo` -> "HS List: Launch_Demo_Queue_2026"; `View technical benchmarks` -> "HS List: Benchmarks_Drip"; `Get on waitlist` -> "HS List: Launch_Waitlist". Will confirm list IDs after this thread.

Noah (Design): Layouts ready. Alpha visual = dev+latency chart overlay; Beta visual = cost savings infographic. Both have mobile-first variants. Drop the final hero copy into Figma link when locked: https://figma.com/file/launch-hero-2026

Liam (Ops): Note on demo cadence: we have limited demo seats in the first 2 weeks. Suggest booking windows only for NA and EMEA initially. APAC conversions -> waitlist by default. Also implement 60s rate limit on the demo form.

Sam (Product): Quick product note: the "up to 3x" number is from our internal test suite on t5-like models at 2k token loads and on our latest quant path. Rosa, can you check the phrasing for public copy? We might need 'in our internal benchmarks' tag.

Rosa (Legal): I'll review. Quick preference: include the qualifier 'in our internal benchmarks' or 'on certain long-context workloads' to be safe. Send the benchmark test doc link and I'll check.

Ava (Content): Revised headline suggestion with qualifier for hero: 'Up to 3x lower median latency on long-context requests.' Subhead: 'Ship LLM features with predictable performance and improved per-token economics.'

Jules (Growth): Plan for A/B test: 10k sessions split over 7 days. Variant A = HERO ALPHA + `Request demo`. Variant B = HERO BETA + `View technical benchmarks`. Keep `Get on waitlist` as tertiary action.

Priya (Demand): HubSpot form mapping (exact fields for Ops):
```
hs_form_name: "launch_inference_2026_v1"
hubspot_owner: "SDR_Launch_Team"
hs_list_name: "Launch_Demo_Queue_2026"
utm_campaign: "launch_inference_q2_2026"
cta_primary: "Request demo"
```

Liam (Ops): Routing rules I'll implement: create HS contact, tag `launch_q2_2026`, post a summarized lead to #sales-live, and limit immediate calendar slots by region. Also adding IP throttle 1/min.

Rosa (Legal): Reviewed. Approve the phrase if copy contains the qualifier. Suggested legal-safe copy: 'In our internal benchmarks, Redwood observed up to 3x lower median generation latency on long-context workloads. Results vary by model and configuration.' Please append that sentence in the benchmarks section.

Ava (Content): Thanks Rosa — will add the exact sentence in the body and keep the hero short: 'Up to 3x lower median latency on long-context requests.'

Noah (Design): Swapped in the short hero in Figma. Also added a small legal footnote component for the benchmark sentence.

publish-bot: Created task 2981 on Marketing Launch board: "Hero copy + legal approval + HubSpot routing" assigned to Ava (Content).

Jules (Growth): After Ava pushes final copy, I'll configure the VWO experiment and wire CTAs to Priya's HS lists. Will post experiment ID here when live. :rocket:

Ava (Content): Final checklist for approval: (1) Legal copy inclusion - Rosa confirmed (2) Design comp locked - Noah done (3) HubSpot names - Priya to confirm list IDs (4) Ops routing + throttle - Liam done. If no objections, I'll mark ready for publish sprint. :thumbsup:
